recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-27803 unless a later work group decision revisits the broader initialSelected versus initial[x] design.
issue_request: FHIR-27803 was a Published FHIR-core Questionnaire change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to address a confusing initialSelected comment that said to use initialSelected when answerValueSet is present, even though answerOption and answerValueSet cannot both be used. The approved resolution was to remove that comment and rely on the invariant that prevents using initial[x] when answerOption is present.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 97fc73a3795794215b6c33d365787cfc3d4bc6df, titled 'FHIR-27803 - Drop comment on answerOption.initialSelected', which deleted the misleading comment from source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion shows the confusion came from the answerValueSet wording, and the 2020-06-11 SDC minutes record the 9-0-0 decision to remove the comment. FHIR-22686, decided in the same meeting, updated the que-11 invariant text to direct users to answerOption.initialSelected when answerOption is present; FHIR-13816 is background for the original addition of initialSelected.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, the authoritative Questionnaire StructureDefinition has no comment on Questionnaire.item.answerOption.initialSelected, que-11 retains the invariant-based guidance cited by the resolution, and a source search found no remaining copy of the removed wording.

related_jiras.note: Same SDC decision set updated que-11 to preserve the invariant-based guidance referenced by FHIR-27803.
Earlier issue introduced answerOption.initialSelected and the original initial[x]/answerOption constraint family.
